• BAKING MIX: Bake a delicious dessert with this tasty brownie mix and cookie mix combination

  • QUICK AND EASY: Make brownie cookie bars by just adding a few ingredients to the baking mixes as directed and popping in the oven

  • ENDLESS OPTIONS: Prepare baking mixes as is or explore the many Betty Crocker creative recipes

  • COOKIE BROWNIE BAR: Enjoy the taste of decadent chocolatey brownie with chocolate chip cookie goodness layered on top

  • CONTAINS: 17.4 oz
features:
Features

Two-in-one mix: Combines brownie and cookie mixes to create layered cookie‑brownie bars. 

Fudgy and chewy texture: Rich brownie base topped with a soft, chocolate chip cookie layer. 

Simple to make: Add a few ingredients (oil, water, egg, butter) and bake—no mixer needed. amazon.com

Generous 17.4 oz package: Yields a 9×9‑inch pan—perfect for family dessert or sharing. amazon.com+1amazon.com+1

Vegetarian and kosher-style: Contains no meat products. 

 Benefits

Decadent dessert mash-up: Enjoy two classic treats in one—brownies plus cookies—ideal for impressing guests or satisfying sweet cravings.

Kid-friendly and fun: Easy enough for kids to help prepare and perfect for school events, potlucks, or busy weeknight treats.

Cost-effective crowd-pleaser: Large batch size offers good value for entertaining or regular servings.

Customizable: Top crescent/variations—add nuts, caramel drizzle, or extra chips to elevate flavor.

No-fuss prep: Quick prep and bake time—usually 30–35 minutes from start to oven.

Highly praised by customers: Rated around 4.7/5; reviewers love the fudgy texture, gooey chunks, and easy preparation:

“Very chocolate thick and gooey and moist”
